question: Do SEMA4D and PLXNB2 show higher whole-liver RNA expression in advanced vs minimal fibrosis in a separately collected human NAFLD cohort?
scope: External retrospective association; not receptor-specific causality, treatment efficacy, longitudinal regression, or independent validation of Kappa. No reported reuse found in Pham main text; supplements not fully audited.
unit: one patient biopsy/library; verify unique GEO, title and BioSample
inclusion: disease=NAFLD and fibrosis stage 0..4; controls excluded
excluded_primary: stage 2 retained only for stage trend
measurement: HTSeq integer counts, GRCh38 Ensembl release 78; remove __ summary rows from denominator; log2(1+1e6*count/total_gene_counts)

tests.effect: mean advanced minus mean minimal log2(CPM+1)
tests.permutation: 9999 random label permutations, two-sided absolute mean contrast, plus-one correction
tests.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across all six prespecified genes
tests.interval: 2000 bootstrap resamples of each group, percentile 95%, unadjusted descriptive

sensitivity: minimum and maximum leave-one-patient-out primary effect
Spearman correlation with numeric fibrosis stage among all NAFLD samples, descriptive, average tied ranks
acceptance: Pair concordance requires BOTH target genes positive, BH q<0.05 and descriptive lower CI>0; reported association only. Negative/mixed result retained unchanged. No therapeutic success threshold.
missingness: fail on duplicate genes/GEO/title/BioSample, missing target or mismatched files, negative/noninteger counts; do not impute or tune exclusions

resource_budget.local_ai: one existing hermes3 task, 120s; no retries

statistical_limits: cross-sectional, cell mixture, unadjusted sex/age/batch/unavailable covariates
no temporal, cellular or drug response inference
current stable Ensembl IDs cross-checked against original count IDs; no identifier substitution
